# To Spec

## What it does

Turn aligned decisions into a feature spec.

## When to reach for it

Alignment is settled and the work needs a durable, implementation-ready behavior contract.

## Where it fits

Second in the workflow chain. It turns the alignment brief into a spec for `$to-tickets`. The catalog stage is `spec`. Previous stages: `$grill-with-docs`.

## Prerequisites

- No external tool dependency is declared.

## It is working if

- The spec states the problem, solution, user stories, decisions, testing decisions, and out-of-scope work.
- The spec names public seams and observable behavior without pretending implementation details are settled.

## Invocation

Use `$to-spec` when you want this skill explicitly. It is explicit-only.
